node.title: DLI WCL consumer interface requires the raw primitive-orbit ledger
node.statement: C1' consumes the raw weighted sum over every reduced primitive signed-vanisher orbit in its window. Multiplier shadows, additive clusters, and level lifts remain lattice points priced at their own level and weight; first-owner classification cannot delete their mass without a separate transfer theorem. Hence WCL-ZONE must bound the raw ledger. At the actual low levels ell in {1,2,4,8}, the bound is still equivalent to primitive-window emptiness; from ell=16 onward exact raw multiplicity matters.
